Ready to strengthen and tone your entire body — all while staying on your feet? This 24-minute full body resistance band workout is designed for anyone who wants an effective strength session without ever getting down on the floor (perfect for men and women 50+).
This workout is great for building strength, improving muscle tone, and supporting your balance and mobility, all in a format that's accessible no matter where you're starting from.
What you'll need:
A resistance band (light to medium resistance works well for most beginners)
